reviews.author: Jestina John
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of going on the Serengeti Safari with Tanzania Hugs Safaris and it was truly an unforgettable experience! From start to finish, everything was handled with exceptional professionalism and care.

Our guide was incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, and passionate about the wildlife, which made the safari so much more enjoyable. The Serengeti itself is awe-inspiring, and seeing the Big Five in their natural habitat was a dream come true. Tanzania Hugos Safaris made sure we had the best spots and views, and we were able to witness some amazing moments, including a lioness hunting and a herd of elephants crossing the road!

The accommodations were also top-notch comfortable and situated in the perfect locations. The entire team went above and beyond to ensure our comfort and safety, and the food was delicious!

I highly recommend Tanzania Hugs Safaris to anyone looking for an authentic and professional safari experience. They truly go the extra mile, and I’ll definitely be returning for more adventures in the future

reviews.author: Philipp Daud
reviews.text:
I had an incredible experience with Tanzania Hugo's Safaris from the first inquiry to the final drop-off, everything was handled with professionalism, warmth, and attention to detail. The team was friendly, knowledgeable, and very accommodating to our needs.

Our guide was absolutely amazing deeply knowledgeable about wildlife, the parks, and Tanzanian culture. We were able to see the Big Five and so many other animals up close, all while feeling safe and well taken care of. The vehicle was comfortable and well-equipped, and the accommodations they selected were clean, scenic, and offered great food.

What stood out the most was their personal touch and genuine passion for giving guests an authentic and memorable safari experience. Hugo himself checked in with us several times to make sure everything was going smoothly a rare and appreciated gesture.

Highly recommended to anyone looking for a reliable, ethical, and unforgettable safari in Tanzania. I would definitely book with them again!

reviews.author: victor mtopwa
reviews.text: I had an unforgettable experience with Hugos Safari in Tanzania! From the moment I arrived, I was taken aback by the breathtaking landscapes. Our guide, John, was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about the wildlife and the region, making every game drive an educational adventure. We saw all of the Big Five, including a rare leopard sighting! The accommodations were top-notch, with a beautiful lodge overlooking the Serengeti plains, and the food was amazing. The highlight was definitely a sunrise hot air balloon ride over the Serengeti absolutely magical! I highly recommend Hugos Safari for anyone looking for a once-in-a-lifetime adventure in Tanzania!
